technical.summary: Strong trend structure with price above all major moving averages and ADX confirmation, but momentum oscillators show weakness and MACD remains bearish, limiting conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: EQT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 90 days—insufficient smart money alignment to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (21/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent congressional conviction and unavailable news sentiment limit conviction; neutral AAII reading suggests mixed retail positioning.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (416.64), flat yield curve recession risk, rising dollar headwind, and 90-day earnings binary create highly unfavourable macro conditions for EQT trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong trend structure (ADX, EMA alignment, price above major MAs, OBV bullish) with extreme fear sentiment (21/100) creating contrarian buy opportunity near support at 36.27.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is crisis-level (VIX 416.64, flat yield curve, rising dollar), fundamental conviction is absent (no insider/institutional buying, high earnings risk in 90 days), and momentum oscillators (MACD negative, RSI weak, StochRSI oversold) show deteriorating internal strength despite trend structure.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical trend structure is sound (ADX strong, price above major MAs, OBV bullish) and extreme fear sentiment (21/100) creates contrarian opportunity. However, macro crisis regime (VIX 416.64), absent fundamental conviction (zero smart money signals), and 90-day earnings binary overwhelm technical setup.
decision.primary_risk: Macro environment in crisis mode with flat yield curve recession risk and rising dollar headwind; earnings in 90 days create binary event risk that invalidates swing trade thesis.
decision.portfolio_note: Zero sector concentration risk, but portfolio already contains 238 open positions; adding speculative swing trade in crisis macro environment adds unnecessary tail risk.
